status: source-reviewed canonical transformations; ambiguous provider event ownership remains explicitly flagged

common.scope: Inherited canonical state after a completed source week, predicting a later game. Filter to regular-season source rows, coerce numerics, collapse duplicate fingerprint keys (season/team/week) using means for performance fields and first values for other fields, then sort and aggregate within team-season. The frozen experiment availability checks remain authoritative.
common.aggregation_note: Equal weight per nonmissing canonical source row, not a pooled event numerator/denominator. Duplicate-key collapse precedes this average. Bye/scheduled missing rows do not supply a new finite observation; completed counts have separate logic.
common.minimum_sample_rule: One finite canonical source value; absent observations remain missing until observed, except explicitly recorded upstream zero-fill rules.
common.garbage_time_handling: No additional play filtering in these cleaners or cumulative state transforms. Game totals and supplied box-score values retain their source inclusion rules.
common.missingness_note: After numeric coercion, missing values are filled with zero only for these present provider columns: stat_interceptionTDs, stat_passesIntercepted, stat_puntReturns, stat_puntReturnTDs, stat_kickReturnTDs, stat_kickReturns, stat_totalFumbles. Other absent or nonnumeric values remain missing. This is upstream behavior, separate from model missing-value handling.

games_played.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative source-support count. completed_target prefers target_team_margin, then target_points_for; if neither column exists the implementation counts all rows.
games_played.film_intuition: Amount of completed evidence behind the cumulative state.

statDef_defensive_tds.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative prior-state count average. A larger count indicates more recorded events, not automatically better performance.
statDef_defensive_tds.film_intuition: Prior scoring production in the named play category.

statDef_interceptions.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative count of interceptions thrown; larger is more offensive turnovers, not more defensive takeaways. Zero means none recorded in the source average.
statDef_interceptions.film_intuition: Ball security and risky passing outcomes.
statDef_interceptions.semantic_review: Across 27,403 finite paired 2010-2025 regular-season historical team-game rows, this field equals the opponent passes_intercepted field in 27,337 rows. Of 18,731 rows that distinguish it from the same-team passes_intercepted field, 18,682 agree with the opponent value. The 66 total disagreements remain source-data discrepancies; this is strong empirical ownership evidence, not a repaired provider dataset.
statDef_interceptions.interpretation: Prior average of interceptions thrown by the represented team, inferred from paired source-game ownership; the statDef canonical prefix is misleading.

travel_distance_diff.units: dimensionless log-distance difference (distances evaluated in kilometers)
travel_distance_diff.positive_negative_meaning: Positive means the team travels farther than its opponent to the source-game venue; negative means less travel.
travel_distance_diff.film_intuition: Historical relative travel burden, averaged over source rows; not an upcoming-trip mileage field.
travel_distance_diff.distance_equation_excel: =2*6371.0088*ASIN(SQRT(SIN(RADIANS(venue_lat-team_lat)/2)^2+COS(RADIANS(team_lat))*COS(RADIANS(venue_lat))*SIN(RADIANS(venue_lon-team_lon)/2)^2)); repeat with opponent coordinates for opponent_distance_km.

travel_tz_diff.positive_negative_meaning: Positive means greater time-zone displacement for the team than the opponent; negative means less.
travel_tz_diff.film_intuition: Historical relative time-zone burden, averaged over source rows.
